Levels.facedetection: Face detection task: whole scene visible, 6 s limit.
Levels.movingwindow: Moving-window task: only a gaze-contingent aperture around fixation visible, 20 s limit.

effect.Description: Effect of the 2 (condition) x 2 (face visible, masked) repeated-measures ANOVA with images as replicates. The dependent variable is the log of each image's held-out squared prediction error, averaged over the folds in which it is a test item, with log latency z-scored within condition.

Levels.main effect of mask: Main effect of masking the face.
Levels.condition (not interpretable): Main effect of preview condition; confounded by the different reliabilities of the two conditions.

eta2p_ci90_low.Description: Lower bound of the 90% CI of eta2p.

eta2p_ci90_high.Description: Upper bound of the 90% CI of eta2p.

r2_preview_visible.Description: Noise-corrected single-feature predictivity of the CNN predictor computed from the unmasked images. Condition: preview.

r2_preview_masked.Description: Noise-corrected single-feature predictivity of the CNN predictor computed with the face region occluded by a grey mask. Condition: preview.

r2_no_preview_visible.Description: Noise-corrected single-feature predictivity of the CNN predictor computed from the unmasked images. Condition: no-preview.

r2_no_preview_masked.Description: Noise-corrected single-feature predictivity of the CNN predictor computed with the face region occluded by a grey mask. Condition: no-preview.
